questions.q: What does criticality refer to in a nuclear reactor?
options: The total shutdown of the reactor
The initiation of a self-sustaining nuclear fission reaction
questions.explain: 🔍 Criticality is crucial for a nuclear reactor as it helps sustain the chain reaction without external sources. It’s the point where fission keeps going on its own, but electricity generation is not yet achieved! ⚛️

questions.q: What is the scientific name of the Indian Softshell Turtle?
